Hey, I’m Tony.

I’m 20 and currently working on evals for Gemini at Google. Previously, I worked at Cognition, xAI, and Scale AI, and did research at Arc Institute and the Stanford AI Lab.

At Stanford, I co-led ACM and helped organize TreeHacks. I’m also interested in philosophy, angel investing, and making small, occasionally useful things just to see if they can exist.
